Setting up a well-organized bookmark system will save you time and help you stay focused on learning data science rather than searching for links. ::: {.callout-note} ## Chrome-focused instructions Based on our course registration data, approximately 67% of participants use Google Chrome. These instructions are written specifically for Chrome users. If you're using a different browser, the general concepts still apply but menu locations and keyboard shortcuts may differ. ::: ## Step 1: Create a dedicated bookmarks folder in Chrome 1. Open Chrome. ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-chrome-open.png){width=100%} 2. Click on the *three dots menu* in the top-right corner. ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-three-dots-menu.png){width=100%} 3. Click on *Bookmarks and Lists* ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-bookmarks-and-lists.png){width=100%} 4. Click on *Show Bookmarks Bar*. A bookmarks bar appears below the address bar in your browser. It might have already been there. ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-show-bookmarks-bar.png){width=100%} 5. Right-click on the bookmarks bar and select *Add Folder...*. ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-add-folder.png){width=100%} 6. Name the folder `ds4owd-002` in the Name files. Ensure that in the window below, *Bookmarks Bar* is selected as the location. ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-name-folder.png){width=100%} 7. Click *Save*. ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-save-folder.png){width=100%} 8. The folder `ds4owd-002` should now appear in your bookmarks bar. ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-folder-created.png){width=100%} ## Step 2: Add course website to your folder 1. Navigate to the course website: [{{< var course.website >}}]({{< var course.website >}}) 2. Click the *star icon* in the address bar. 3. In the popup, add *course website* for the Name filed. 4. Click the *Folder* dropdown and select your `ds4owd-002` folder. 5. Click *Done*. 6. Click on your `ds4owd-002` folder in the bookmarks bar to verify the bookmark was added. ## Step 3: Add other essential course links Add the following bookmarks to your [ds4owd-002]{.highlight-yellow} folder. For each bookmark, follow the instructions as in Step 2. ### Essential course links 2. **Posit Cloud workspace**: [{{< var platforms.posit-cloud >}}]({{< var platforms.posit-cloud >}}) - Name it: [Posit Cloud - ds4owd]{.highlight-yellow} ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-add-posit-cloud.png){width=100%} 3. **GitHub organization**: [{{< var course.github-org >}}]({{< var course.github-org >}}) - Name it: [GitHub - Course Org]{.highlight-yellow} ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-add-github-org.png){width=100%} 4. **Element chat**: - Name it: [Element Chat]{.highlight-yellow} ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-add-element.png){width=100%} ## Step 3: Take a screenshot 1. Click on your `ds4owd-002` folder in the bookmarks bar to verify all bookmarks were added correctly. ## Step 3: Create sub-folders for better organization in Chrome (optional) As the course progresses, organize your Chrome bookmarks with sub-folders: 1. Right-click on your [ds4owd-002]{.highlight-yellow} folder 3. Select [Add new folder]{.highlight-yellow} 3. Create these sub-folders: - [Assignments]{.highlight-yellow} - for your personal assignment repositories - [Resources]{.highlight-yellow} - for R documentation, package sites - [Data]{.highlight-yellow} - for OpenWashData and other data sources ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-subfolders.png){width=100%} ### Recommended additional bookmarks Add these to your [Resources]{.highlight-yellow} sub-folder: - **R for Data Science book**: - **ggplot2 documentation**: - **RStudio cheatsheets**: - **OpenWashData**: ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-resources-folder.png){width=100%} ## Step 4: Use Chrome bookmark shortcuts (optional) Speed up your workflow with Chrome's built-in shortcuts: 1. Open Chrome's bookmark manager ([Ctrl+Shift+O]{.highlight-yellow} / [Cmd+Shift+O]{.highlight-yellow}) 2. Right-click on frequently-used bookmarks 3. Select [Edit]{.highlight-yellow} 4. In the [Name]{.highlight-yellow} field, you can see the bookmark name 5. Unfortunately, Chrome doesn't support custom keywords directly, but you can: - Use [Ctrl+Shift+B]{.highlight-yellow} to show/hide the bookmarks bar for quick access - Drag frequently-used bookmarks to the leftmost positions on your bookmarks bar - Use Chrome's address bar autocomplete by typing the first few letters of the bookmark name ![](images/bookmarks/screenshot-bookmark-shortcut.png){width=100%} ::: {.callout-tip} ## Sync Chrome bookmarks across devices To sync your bookmarks across all your devices: 1. Click your [profile icon]{.highlight-yellow} in the top-right corner of Chrome 2. Click [Turn on sync]{.highlight-yellow} 3. Sign in with your Google account 4. Your ds4owd-002 bookmarks will now be available on all devices where you're signed into Chrome ::: ## Step 5: Verify your setup Check that you have easy access to all essential course resources: 1. Can you reach the [course website]{.highlight-yellow} in 2 clicks or less? 2. Can you access your [Posit Cloud workspace]{.highlight-yellow} quickly? 3. Is your [GitHub organization]{.highlight-yellow} bookmark working? 4. Can you open [Element chat]{.highlight-yellow} when you need help? If you answered yes to all questions, you're ready to focus on learning! ::: {.callout-warning} ## Keep bookmarks updated As you create new repositories for assignments, remember to bookmark them. Having quick access to your work will save time throughout the course. ::: ## Troubleshooting Chrome bookmarks **Bookmarks bar not visible?** - Press [Ctrl+Shift+B]{.highlight-yellow} (Windows/Linux) or [Cmd+Shift+B]{.highlight-yellow} (Mac) to toggle the bookmarks bar - Or: [Three dots menu]{.highlight-yellow} → [Bookmarks and lists]{.highlight-yellow} → [Show bookmarks bar]{.highlight-yellow} **Can't find your bookmarks?** - Open bookmark manager: [Ctrl+Shift+O]{.highlight-yellow} / [Cmd+Shift+O]{.highlight-yellow} - Use the search box at the top to find specific bookmarks - Check if they're in [Other bookmarks]{.highlight-yellow} or [Mobile bookmarks]{.highlight-yellow} folders **Bookmarks not syncing?** - Click your profile icon and check if you're signed in - Go to [chrome://settings/syncSetup]{.highlight-yellow} to verify sync is enabled for bookmarks ::: {.callout-tip} ## Need help? {{< fa envelope-circle-check >}} If you're having trouble setting up your bookmarks, post a message in the Element chat or email us at ghe@mavt.ethz.ch ::: ## Next steps Now that you have your bookmarks organized, continue with the next assignment where you'll use these bookmarks to navigate between the course platforms efficiently.
